description:
OnSkin is your science-backed ingredient checker and product scanner for skincare, makeup, hair care, and household products—trusted by over 8 million users.

Not sure what's actually in the products you use every day? OnSkin decodes ingredient labels, so you know which products are made with clean ingredients—whether you're checking what you already own or scanning before you buy. It's backed by a curated database of 2 million products, from viral K-beauty finds to everyday drugstore staples.

INGREDIENT CHECKER
Wondering what’s inside that face cream? Scan it and find out. OnSkin is your cosmetic checker for skincare, makeup, hair care, and more, giving you a clear verdict—Excellent, Good, Not Great, or Bad—plus plain-language notes on every ingredient. If it scores low, OnSkin suggests safer alternatives.

SKINCARE FINDER
Overwhelmed by choice in the skincare aisle? Answer a short questionnaire about your skin type and goals—think moisturizing, calming, or anti-acne—and OnSkin curates matching beauty products, from face cleansers to sunscreen. Less guessing in the store.

SKINCARE ROUTINE
Want a routine that actually fits your skin? Complete your Skin Profile, and OnSkin builds a personalized morning and evening skincare routine around your skin type and goals, so every step makes sense.

SHELF SCAN
Tired of scanning products one at a time? Shelf Scan reads your entire bathroom cabinet in one go and delivers safety and quality scores on the spot.

SKIN MATCH
Wondering if a product's right for you? OnSkin skips generic "clean beauty" labels and checks it against your skin type, sensitivities, concerns, and goals—then gives you a clear verdict on whether the product is a match.

ONSKIN COMMUNITY
Curious how other people handle the same skin or hair concerns? Join the OnSkin Community to swap tips, ask questions, and get inspired by real skincare journeys.

HAIR LAB
Not sure if your shampoo or conditioner suits your hair type? OnSkin goes beyond the skincare scanner, checking any hair product against your hair type and goals. Your Hair Match score shows how well it fits, so you can build a hair care routine that works for you.

AI SKIN HELPER
Need quick advice on your skin type or the latest beauty trend? Ask your own question or pick a popular one and get personalized guidance from the AI Skin Helper in seconds.

MORE TO EXPLORE
Check your local UV Index, browse trending Popular Scans, or test your instincts with the daily Guess the Score game.

WHY TRUST ONSKIN
–  Independent safety ratings for skincare, hair care, makeup, and household products—no brand deals, no sponsored reviews.
–  Grounded in toxicology and dermatology research, with 15,000+ ingredients analyzed for safety, quality, and toxicity.
–  Recommendations and scoring criteria reviewed by our in-house team of certified dermatologists.
–  No vague "non-toxic" claims—just clear, honest ingredient explanations.
–  Proud partner of the Skin Cancer Foundation.

RECOGNITION
Featured in Forbes, CNN, Vogue, and The Independent. Double winner of a 2024 Webby Award and a New York Product Design Award.

FAQ
Q: Is OnSkin good for acne-prone skin?
A: Yes—Skin Match flags acne-safe products based on your skin profile.
Q: What if a product isn't in the database yet?
A: Request an On-Demand Analysis and get its safety score in just a few hours.
Q: Can I check household and cleaning products too?
A: Yes—OnSkin analyzes household and cleaning products with the same expert-reviewed safety ratings.

Download OnSkin—your all-in-one ingredient checker and product scanner for skincare, makeup, hair care, and household essentials—and stop guessing what’s in your products.

PREMIUM SUBSCRIPTION

–  Subscriptions are billed automatically based on the selected subscription plan.
